h: Joke Jigan questions why Lagos socialites were missing from Zlatan's wedding
p: Entertainer Joke Jigan has reportedly asked why many well-known Lagos socialites were not seen at Zlatan Ibile's wedding. Her comment has added to the online conversation about the ceremony.
more: The wedding has stayed in the headlines since the weekend, with guests and gifts widely discussed.
The couple have not responded to the comment.
